config.description: The name of the instance's configuration which defines the geographic placement and replication of your databases in this instance.
config.rationale: The config field determines where data is stored geographically. While it does not directly introduce a security risk, it should be set to a region that complies with data residency requirements.

display_name.description: The descriptive name for this instance as it appears in UIs. Must be unique per project and between 4 and 30 characters in length.
display_name.rationale: The display name is a required identifier for the instance. It does not directly introduce a security risk but should follow naming conventions for clarity.

name.description: A unique identifier for the instance, which cannot be changed after the instance is created.
name.rationale: The instance name is an optional identifier. It does not directly introduce a security risk but should follow naming conventions to avoid confusion.

num_nodes.description: The number of nodes allocated to this instance.
num_nodes.rationale: The number of nodes affects availability and performance but does not directly introduce a security risk.

processing_units.description: The number of processing units allocated to this instance.
processing_units.rationale: Processing units affect availability and performance but do not directly introduce a security risk.

labels.description: An object containing a list of key-value pairs for labelling the instance.
labels.rationale: Labels are used for organisation and cost allocation. They do not directly introduce a security risk but can be used to enforce governance policies.

autoscaling_config.description: The autoscaling configuration. Autoscaling is enabled if this field is set.
autoscaling_config.rationale: Autoscaling configuration affects performance and cost but does not directly introduce a security risk.

autoscaling_limits.description: Defines the minimum and maximum compute capacity allocated to the instance.
autoscaling_limits.rationale: Autoscaling limits affect performance and cost but do not directly introduce a security risk.

autoscaling_targets.description: Defines target utilization metrics for autoscaling.
autoscaling_targets.rationale: Autoscaling targets affect performance and cost but do not directly introduce a security risk.

asymmetric_autoscaling_options.description: Asymmetric autoscaling options for specific replicas.
asymmetric_autoscaling_options.rationale: Asymmetric autoscaling options affect performance but do not directly introduce a security risk.

edition.description: The edition selected for this instance. Possible values are: EDITION_UNSPECIFIED, STANDARD, ENTERPRISE, ENTERPRISE_PLUS.
edition.rationale: The edition affects available features and pricing but does not directly introduce a security risk.

instance_type.description: The type of this instance. Possible values are: PROVISIONED, FREE_INSTANCE.
instance_type.rationale: The instance type affects available features and quotas but does not directly introduce a security risk.

default_backup_schedule_type.description: Controls the default backup behavior for new databases within the instance. Possible values are: NONE, AUTOMATIC.
default_backup_schedule_type.rationale: Setting a default backup schedule ensures new databases are automatically backed up, reducing the risk of data loss in the event of accidental deletion or corruption.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: The project field is optional and defaults to the provider project. It does not directly introduce a security risk but should be explicitly set to avoid deploying resources to unintended projects.

force_destroy.description: This must be set to true if you want to delete the instance even if it contains databases.
force_destroy.rationale: Enabling force_destroy allows a Cloud Spanner instance to be destroyed even if it contains databases, risking permanent and irreversible data loss.
force_destroy.compliant:
resource "google_spanner_instance" "c1" {
  config       = "regional-us-central1"
  display_name = "c1"
  name         = "c1"
  num_nodes    = 1
  force_destroy = false
}
force_destroy.non-compliant:
resource "google_spanner_instance" "nc1" {
  config       = "regional-us-central1"
  display_name = "nc1"
  name         = "nc1"
  num_nodes    = 1
  force_destroy = true
}

autoscaling_limits.description: Defines the minimum and maximum compute capacity for autoscaling.
autoscaling_limits.rationale: Autoscaling limits affect performance and cost but do not directly introduce a security risk.

min_processing_units.description: Specifies minimum number of processing units allocated to the instance.
min_processing_units.rationale: Minimum processing units affect performance but do not directly introduce a security risk.

max_processing_units.description: Specifies maximum number of processing units allocated to the instance.
max_processing_units.rationale: Maximum processing units affect performance but do not directly introduce a security risk.

min_nodes.description: The minimum number of nodes for this specific replica.
min_nodes.rationale: Minimum nodes affect availability but do not directly introduce a security risk.

max_nodes.description: The maximum number of nodes for this specific replica.
max_nodes.rationale: Maximum nodes affect availability but do not directly introduce a security risk.

autoscaling_targets.description: Defines target utilization metrics for autoscaling.
autoscaling_targets.rationale: Autoscaling targets affect performance and cost but do not directly introduce a security risk.

high_priority_cpu_utilization_percent.description: Specifies the target high priority cpu utilization percentage for autoscaling.
high_priority_cpu_utilization_percent.rationale: CPU utilization targets affect performance but do not directly introduce a security risk.

storage_utilization_percent.description: Specifies the target storage utilization percentage for autoscaling.
storage_utilization_percent.rationale: Storage utilization targets affect performance but do not directly introduce a security risk.

asymmetric_autoscaling_options.description: Asymmetric autoscaling options for specific replicas.
asymmetric_autoscaling_options.rationale: Asymmetric autoscaling options affect performance but do not directly introduce a security risk.

replica_selection.description: A nested object resource for selecting the replica to apply asymmetric autoscaling options.
replica_selection.rationale: Replica selection is required for asymmetric autoscaling but does not directly introduce a security risk.

overrides.description: A nested object resource for overriding autoscaling limits for specific replicas.
overrides.rationale: Overrides affect performance but do not directly introduce a security risk.

replica_selection.description: Defines which replica to apply asymmetric autoscaling options to.
replica_selection.rationale: Replica selection affects performance but does not directly introduce a security risk.

location.description: The location of the replica to apply asymmetric autoscaling options.
location.rationale: The replica location affects data residency but does not directly introduce a security risk on its own.

overrides.description: Defines autoscaling limit overrides for specific replicas.
overrides.rationale: Overrides affect performance and cost but do not directly introduce a security risk.

autoscaling_limits.description: A nested object resource for defining autoscaling limit overrides.
autoscaling_limits.rationale: Autoscaling limit overrides affect performance but do not directly introduce a security risk.
